senses.gloss: m. (redupl. of זעט, v. זוּטָּא) young man, youth, student.—Pl. זַעֲטוּטִים, constr. זַעֲטוּטֵי (a Variant of נערי, Ex. XXIV, 5, because נערי admits of the meaning of servants, slaves, Greek παιδές).
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 356:14">Sifré Deut. 356</cite> (v. <cite ref="M02083"><he>מָעוֹן</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00331"><he>הִיא</he></cite>) and one manuscript existed in the Temple which was named <he>ספר זעטוטים</he> the Book of Zaʿăṭûṭim (containing <cite ref="G00592"><he>זעטוטי</he></cite> for <he>נערי</he>); <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 6:4">Treat. Sof’rim VI, 4</cite> <he>זאטוטי</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2:12">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="G00592"><he>זעטוטי</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Megillah 9a:16">Meg. 9ᵃ</cite> (reported as one of the changes in the Greek translation of the Pentateuch, and ref. to <he>נערי</he> l. c., and to <he>אצילי</he> <cite ref="Exodus 24:11">Ex. XXIV, 11</cite>) <he>זאטוטי</he> ed. (Ms. Par. <he>זע׳</he>, oth. mss. a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 3:8">Yalk. Gen. 3</cite> <he>זטוטי</he>) ‘the youths’ (νεανίσκοι, in place of παιδές, v. LXX Ex. l. c.).
